services.desc: Explore Asheville! Approximately 3 hours About We have devised a bike tour route of Asheville that follows the safest, bike-friendly streets and greenways around town to see the best of Asheville. At each historic stop along the way, we will tell the story of the landmark and the people that made it happen. Get a feel for not only the history of Asheville, but also the artsy, thriving city it has become today. What Is Included Electric Bike Helmet Spring Water. Please bring your own water bottle. See Asheville’s noteworthy architectural gems, take in the stunning mountain scenery from carefully chosen viewpoints, and hear the stories behind Asheville’s best historic sites.
